title: Can You Choose the Route on a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Partly. Both Chifbay trips run a set route west of Funchal, but you can ask for longer at one stop or to skip another. The sea and the clock decide the rest.
heroAlt: A motor boat seen from above making a wide curving turn off Ponta do Sol
